posts.title: Using a Language Model to Write My Blog Would Be Disrespectful to My Audience and Worse Than Pointless
posts.description: I want to quickly address, with laser focus, a most pertinent part of the LLM discussion: I have no interest, and I shall never have any interest, in using text generation for the writing on this blog. I declare this with utmost certainty. Thus: I swear to never use an LLM to generate or assist with any writing on this website, intended for consumption by people, except as immediately disclaimed.
